title: M6 Metering and spend ceilings
description:
Milestone of epic PPY-6a6357 (initiative PPY-25ffa3). Critical-path plan: PPY-e38a2d. Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR #1305).

Entry criteria: M4 (runs alongside M5); Prospectus cost accounting: usage queue for product papyrus enabled (kanbus-71ff98, flag on with Ryan's approval), shared-tier ledger checks (kanbus-f45f7f), quota on real cost (kanbus-c7be53, merged); the @anthus/cost-accounting package vendored and a Python sender twin available.
Exit criteria: PPY-25e0d7 (our dedicated sites tagged and reporting), PPY-3fd951, PPY-889ab5, PPY-49d059, PPY-f40a02; operator view of cost per tenant; PPY-04ce84 written with measured numbers.
Customer-visible: Internal only (operators). Customers see percent of weekly quota only, never dollars.
Index-adding deploys in this milestone: None.
Contains: PPY-25e0d7, PPY-f98e05, PPY-3fd951, PPY-889ab5, PPY-49d059, PPY-f40a02, PPY-04ce84
Not gating: PPY-8a3c6a usage billing beyond the quota (commercial; after M7).
Follows: M4.

Acceptance (Gherkin):
Scenario: An untagged resource fails CI (features_backend/cost-accounting-reports.feature, PPY-f98e05)
Scenario: A model call on a dedicated site reaches the cost ledger once (same file, PPY-25e0d7)
Scenario: A model call is reported once to the tenant's Account (features_backend/metering-events.feature, PPY-3fd951)
Scenario: An unknown item kind is noticed, not free (same file)
Scenario: A tenant over its weekly budget cannot start model work (features_backend/model-spend-ceiling.feature, PPY-889ab5)
Scenario: Serving is not affected by the budget (same file)
Scenario: The daily report reads counters, not content (features_backend/platform-usage-report.feature, PPY-49d059)
Scenario: A burst far outside a tenant's normal rate is slowed and reported (features_backend/tenant-adaptive-throttle.feature, PPY-f40a02)
Scenario: The model explains a month of a small tenant (PPY-04ce84)

Acceptance checks:
1. For one dedicated site, a week of Prospectus ledger totals by category is within an agreed tolerance of Cost Explorer and the OpenAI usage report (tolerance recorded on PPY-25e0d7).
2. Prospectus refusal log shows no unknown Papyrus item kinds for 7 days.
3. Shared-stack usage per tenant sums to the shared cost line with unattributed overhead reported, not hidden.

comments.text: Now depends on PPY-25e0d7: usage goes through the Prospectus SQS sender library with the attribution convention app=papyrus, deployment=site id, Account UUID per site; shared resources tagged anthus:account=shared and split by reported usage.
